race.description: Www.horseandhound.com.au Norms Daughter Preview Ms Pace
race.comment: DELIGHTFUL PEG NZ (1) brings strong form into this, putting together a string of wins and placings including a third at G3 level from a wider barrier last time. Won five of her other six tries at this distance, leading to score from this barrier three back. The draw should see her tough to catch. COPY CAT QUEEN (9) lines up for the hat-trick after beating Delightful Peg for a 5m success in The Schrader at this circuit and distance last start, getting home by 5 metres. The wide draws makes this a tough challenge but winning form is hard to knock. BEACH DIAMOND (2) is back form a six week freshen and gets her lowest draw since crossing from Victoria. Could show her best tonight. FAKENIT (7) is too good to give up on while UP AND ALIVE (10) chased a good mare last time and draws to trail Delightful Peg. That can drag her into the action.
